{"version": 1, "name": "Key Population PIP", "disaggregation": {"version": 1, "ageCategoryUuid": "6c1a3c5a-1e06-4d43-8c4b-2f1b84a3d001", "ageCategoryCode": "TX_STANDARD", "genders": ["F", "M"]}, "indicators": [{"indicatorUuid": "6e676aa0-df0f-4baf-b906-04c388a1406e", "kind": "BASE", "code": "TX_CURR_KP_PIPS", "name": "TX-CURR-KP PIPS", "sortOrder": 1, "sql": {"compiled": "WITH base_pop AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT patient_id
  FROM encounter_table a
  JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp
    ON mdp.patient_id = a.patient_id
  WHERE a.encounter_date >= :startDate
    AND a.encounter_date < :endDate
    AND mdp.birthdate IS NOT NULL
    AND mdp.gender IS NOT NULL
),
ag AS (
  SELECT
    ag.age_group_id,
    ag.label,
    ag.min_age_days,
    ag.max_age_days,
    ag.sort_order
  FROM report_builder_dim_age_group ag
  JOIN report_builder_dim_age_category ac
    ON ac.age_category_id = ag.age_category_id
  WHERE ac.code = 'TX_STANDARD'
    AND ag.is_active = 1
),
genders AS (
  SELECT 'F' AS gender UNION ALL SELECT 'M' AS gender
),
cnt AS (
  SELECT
    ag.age_group_id AS age_group_id,
    mdp.gender AS gender,
    COUNT(DISTINCT base_pop.patient_id) AS value
  FROM base_pop
  JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp
    ON mdp.patient_id = base_pop.patient_id
  JOIN ag
    ON TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, mdp.birthdate, :endDate)
       BETWEEN ag.min_age_days AND ag.max_age_days
  WHERE mdp.birthdate IS NOT NULL
    AND mdp.gender IS NOT NULL
    AND mdp.gender IN ('F','M')
  GROUP BY ag.age_group_id, mdp.gender
)
SELECT
  ag.label AS age_group,
  g.gender AS gender,
  COALESCE(cnt.value, 0) AS value
FROM ag
CROSS JOIN genders g
LEFT JOIN cnt
  ON cnt.age_group_id = ag.age_group_id
 AND cnt.gender = g.gender
ORDER BY ag.sort_order, g.gender;", "strategy": "BASE+SECTION_DISAGG", "inputs": {"sectionAgeCategoryCode": "TX_STANDARD", "sectionGenders": ["F", "M"]}}}], "exchangeMappings": {"dhis2": {"version": 1, "enabled": false, "periodType": "Monthly", "orgUnitStrategy": "location", "mappingMode": "dataElement-categoryOptionCombo", "indicatorMappings": [{"indicatorUuid": "6e676aa0-df0f-4baf-b906-04c388a1406e", "categoryOptionComboByDisagg": {}}]}}, "compiledAt": "2026-08-08T13:42:48.086884"}
